## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue if one exists.

## Validation

List the focused checks actually run and the environment. Distinguish simulation,
local SDK loopback and real-device evidence. State checks that remain unverified.

## Review

- [ ] New APIs or CLI behavior are documented.
- [ ] Camera units, coordinate frames and timestamps remain explicit.
- [ ] No private recordings, device profiles, credentials or generated assets are included.
- [ ] Applicable upstream model licenses and provenance are preserved.
